newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures surge on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures surge on technical buying.

text.p: The Tokyo corn futures market surged on Wednesday, with distant four months up by the their daily 500 yen limit at the close as heavy technical buying by local investors emerged, traders said.
Limitless November ended up 840 yen at 16,310 yen a tonne, and benchmark September month was up 500 yen at 16,000.
The daily volume was 78,459 lots. Open interest in corn futures as of September 30 was 468,458 lots, down from 519,802 as of September 2.
"Local investors felt recent price plunges were excessive and actively bought from the opening," a brokerage trader said.
